messages:
ajay: Heads-up — planning to cut release/1.13 tomorrow at 16:00 PT. Can owners confirm backports, changelog lines, and any blocking migrations? :bell:

sasha: I can own the branch creation + origin push. Will wait for final OK on backports. :+1:

maria: Two backports pending: #4321 (kv-cache fix) and #4330 (metrics tag). Both have green CI but need a quick review for changelog text.

kevin: I reviewed #4321, left one nits comment. Will approve after that. For #4330 I flagged a logging change that might affect SLO alerts — marking as needs-qa.

olivia: Changelog draft for both is ready in the docs repo: https://git.internal/redwood/changelogs/pull/215 — can someone skim before cut?

ajay: Thanks — sasha, when you create the branch, can you include the following note in the PR body about backport rules?
```
Backport rules for release/1.13:
- Only merge bugfixes with regression tests or QA signoff.
- No new features unless security/critical.
- Prefer cherry-picks from main; avoid rebasing user PRs.
```

sasha: Yep. Plan is: create branch at 15:50 PT, open the cut PR for review at 15:55, then merge at 16:00 if no hold. I'll post the branch PR link here once created.

diane: Quick reminder: cutoff policy says translations and docs-only changes are post-cut unless urgent. Also watch bundle-size CI flakes; those slow down backports.

release-bot: deploy-checklist: Branch creation window opens in 1h 10m. Required: 2 approvers on cut PR, changelog link, and migration notes (if any).

kevin: For the SLO-impacted logging change in #4330, tagging @olivia for QA. If QA takes longer, we should skip that backport in this cut and include in follow-up patch.

olivia: I'll try to run the quick smoke tomorrow morning, but can't guarantee before 16:00 PT. If QA not done, +1 to skip and do a follow-up 1.13.1.

maria: A heads-up: the backport for #4310 (perf) was reverted last week and is not ready. Not trying to include that one.

ajay: Good call. Sasha — when you open the cut PR, include the checklist in the body and tag me +diane. If anything is skipped, please add the follow-up issues and label `post-cut`.

sasha: Will do. Drafting branch now. Command I'll run: 
```
git fetch upstream
git checkout -b release/1.13 upstream/main
git push origin release/1.13
```
Posting PR in ~2m.

sasha: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/2875 — requesting reviews from @ajay @diane. Add any hold comments within 5m. :eyes:

ajay: Reviewing now. If no holds, we merge at 16:00 PT.

kevin: Approved on code health items, leaving SLO hold on #4330 until QA confirms.

olivia: QA can't finish in time — marking the SLO backport as `hold`. I'll open follow-up issue for 1.13.1.

ajay: OK merging without #4330. Sasha, please: 1) merge cut PR, 2) add `post-cut` issues for skipped backports, 3) tag release notes PR for finalization. :shipit:

sasha: Merge done at 16:00 PT. Branch `release/1.13` created. Post-cut issues created for #4330 and #4310 and linked in the PR.

release-bot: release/1.13 branch created and protected. Automated CI started for branch builds.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll update the changelog PR to remove the held items and add the follow-up notes.

ajay: Great work — I'll post the final release plan doc and schedule the patch cadence. If anything else pops up, ping this thread. :wave:
